sections.title: Changed your mind?
paragraphs: You can cancel your online purchase without giving a reason within 14 days of receiving your toys. This applies to both new and second-hand toys. If an order arrives in separate parcels, this period starts when you receive the last item.
Let us know by email at skplaystudio@gmail.com. You may use the form below, but you do not have to: a clear statement that you wish to cancel, identifying the relevant order, is enough.

sections.title: How to return your toys
paragraphs: Send the toys back within 14 days of telling us that you wish to cancel.
Return address: SK Play Studio, Esther de Boer-van Rijkstraat 136, 1065 GS Amsterdam, Netherlands.
Pack the toys securely to prevent damage in transit and keep proof of postage. You do not need the original packaging to make a return.
You may inspect a toy as you would in a shop. If handling beyond what is necessary to inspect it reduces its value, we may deduct that loss in value and explain how we calculated it.

[To be confirmed: if you have simply changed your mind, you pay the return shipping costs charged by your chosen carrier. For a valid claim involving a defect or an error on our part, we cover the necessary costs.]

sections.title: When you will receive your refund
paragraphs: We will refund you within 14 days of being notified of your cancellation. We may withhold the refund until we receive the toys or evidence that you have sent them back, whichever happens first.

If you return the entire order, we also refund the original standard delivery cost. Any extra cost for a more expensive delivery option you selected is not refundable. For a partial return, we will recalculate the delivery cost based on the items you keep.
We will use your original payment method unless you agree to another method, and we will not charge a refund fee.

sections.title: Faulty items and incorrect orders
paragraphs: If a toy is faulty, does not match its description or is not the item you ordered, email skplaystudio@gmail.com with your order details and a description of the problem. Photos will help us understand what happened.
The 14-day cancellation limit does not apply to these claims. A second-hand toy must also match its description and meet reasonable expectations, taking its age, condition and price into account.

Depending on the circumstances, we will arrange a repair or replacement free of charge. If this is not possible or does not resolve the problem within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience, you may be entitled to a price reduction or cancellation of the purchase under applicable law. A minor defect does not always entitle you to cancel the contract. We cover the necessary costs of a valid claim.

sections.title: Complaints

terms.intro: Last updated: [to be confirmed before publication].

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: The SK Play Studio shop is operated by SK Play Studio, VOF. Address: Esther de Boer-van Rijkstraat 136, 1065 GS Amsterdam, Netherlands. Phone: +31 6 15079494. KVK number: 42124623. Email: skplaystudio@gmail.com. Full business details: Company details.

These terms cover buying toys from us and selling your toys to us through our buyback service. “Buying from us” applies to consumer orders delivered within the Netherlands; “Selling toys to us” applies to our purchases of toys from private individuals.

sections.title: Toys and their condition
paragraphs: We sell both new and second-hand toys. Each product listing states whether the toy is new or second-hand and describes its condition, what is included and any known signs of use or imperfections. Please read the description, view the photos and check the age guidance and warnings before buying.

Follow the age restrictions, instructions and safety warnings provided with the toy, and ensure appropriate adult supervision. If the toy becomes damaged or any parts become loose in a way that could create a safety risk, stop using it and keep it out of children’s reach. Contact us if you have concerns about a toy purchased from us.

These precautions do not limit our legal obligations or your statutory consumer rights. Your statutory rights apply to both new and second-hand toys, including if a toy is faulty or does not match its description.

sections.title: Orders and payment
paragraphs: Before confirming your order, you can check the items, contact details, delivery information and total amount. The order button clearly indicates an obligation to pay.
[To be confirmed: when the contract is concluded.]
We will email you your order details and terms. If you notice an error in your details, please contact us.
Prices are in euros. Shipping costs and any other applicable charges are shown before you confirm your order. For payment methods, payment deadlines and delivery terms, see Shipping & payment.

sections.title: Delivery
paragraphs: We deliver within the agreed timeframe. If no specific timeframe has been agreed, the statutory deadline of no more than 30 days applies.
If delivery is delayed, you retain your statutory rights, including the right to set an additional reasonable deadline and, where the law allows, cancel the contract for a refund.
When delivery is carried out by a carrier we offer, we remain responsible for the goods until you or your designated recipient receives them.

sections.title: Returns and quality
paragraphs: You may cancel your online purchase within 14 days of receiving the goods. The procedure, cancellation form, refund arrangements and information about faulty items are set out in our Refund policy.
These terms do not limit your legal guarantee or other mandatory consumer rights.

sections.title: Selling toys to us
paragraphs: Our buyback service is currently available only within the Netherlands. Home visits are available only in Amsterdam.
You can offer us your toys through Sell to Us. Submitting a request does not oblige you to sell your toys or guarantee that we will buy them.

We assess the toys’ condition and completeness and agree a price with you before buying them. Details of handover, assessment, payment and what happens if the buyback does not proceed are set out in the Buyback terms in Sell to Us.

sections.title: What we collect and why
items: Purchases: your name, contact details, delivery address, order details and payment information — to fulfil our contract and handle returns.

Toy buyback: contact details, toy descriptions and photos, your preferred handover method, the agreed price and payment details — to assess your request, enter into and fulfil a buyback agreement. Please do not include children or other people in your photos.

Correspondence: messages and relevant order details — to answer questions, resolve complaints and protect legal rights. Our basis is the contract or our legitimate interest in handling enquiries and disputes.
Accounting: records of sales and purchases — to meet our tax obligations.
Website operation: necessary technical data — for security and preventing misuse, based on our legitimate interest. [Data collected to be confirmed.]

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, restriction of processing and, where applicable, data portability. You can also object to processing based on legitimate interests.
Where processing relies on consent, you can withdraw it. This does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. We cannot delete information we are legally required to retain.
Email skplaystudio@gmail.com. We normally respond within one month. If a legally permitted extension is needed, we will tell you and explain why.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, the Dutch data protection authority.

sections.title: Updates
paragraphs: We publish a revised policy with an updated date when changes are made. We provide additional notice of significant changes where necessary.

cookies.title: Cookie preferences
cookies.intro: We use necessary cookies to make our website work. With your permission, we may also use optional cookies for analytics and advertising. You can accept them, reject them or choose individual categories. You can change your choices at any time through Cookie preferences in the footer.
